name: 72560 · Mountain View, AR
findings: ZIP 72560 (Mountain View) has 32 nonprofit organizations. 10 of them (31%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 8 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (20% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 72560 (Mountain View) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
50% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 72560 (Mountain View) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.8 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 8 organizations here; 75% of all organizations here have no identified type.
